sfCleanupInstruction: Only safe temporary data is removed — not personal files.
sfDeviceErrInstruction: Open Device Manager and update/reinstall the failing devices.
sfDeviceErrWhy: Device Manager reports hardware with an error.
sfDiskAdviceInstruction: Disk {letter}: review guidance with no dangerous auto actions.
sfGameBarTitle: Game Bar background recording is on
sfGameBarWhy: Background recording can steal resources during games.
sfGameModeWhy: Game Mode helps stabilize frame pacing in games.
sfGamesOnHddInstruction: Move heavy games to an SSD via the launcher or Storage settings.
sfGamesOnHddWhy: Games on HDD take longer to load and stutter more.
sfGpuDriverInstruction: Download a fresh driver from your GPU vendor or Windows Update.
sfGpuDriverWhy: An outdated driver often causes stutters and game issues.
sfOsOnHddInstruction: Check Storage settings. Moving the OS itself is manual.
sfOsOnHddWhy: Windows on a hard disk is noticeably slower than on an SSD.
sfRamConfigInstruction: Enable XMP/DOCP in BIOS/UEFI. Windows can only show system info.
sfRamConfigWhy: Possible single-channel mode or clock below rated (XMP/DOCP).

sfStartupSafeHint: Safe to disable. The app will not start itself, but you can open it manually.
sfUptimeInstruction: Save your work and reboot (Start → Power → Restart).
sfUptimeWhy: Long uptime accumulates background processes and memory leaks.
